online_dependencies: The image caches the selected upstream container digests and builds the selected Flink/Superset images from the exact course source. No Labs or completed tables are baked into the image.

The first image build needs Ubuntu/Docker APT, PyPI, Docker Hub, deb.debian.org and repo.maven.apache.org. Custom-image IDs, context hashes and installed package/artifact inventories are recorded; byte-identical custom-image rebuilds are not promised.
Lab 5 reads the course-bundled WWI history. Lab 4 creates a local temporary lake. The backup drill uses temporary local Silo storage, without a platform backup service.
The ordinary course uses cached containers when available. A source-directed custom-image rebuild can still contact Debian/PyPI/Maven; Docker registry availability is not an offline guarantee.
Only the selected data-warehousing profiles are included; RTA, observability and AI/model access are separate selections.
